claims: Eid prayer occurs after sunrise but before the Dhuhr prayer.
It is Sunnah to take a ghusl before the Eid prayer.
It is Sunnah to eat an odd number of dates before the Eid prayer.
Eid prayer times in Columbus, OH in March 2026 are 8:30 a.m., 9:30 a.m., and 10:30 a.m.
Eid prayer time in Dubai in March 2026 is 6:40 a.m.
Eid prayers are held at designated outdoor community grounds (Eidgah).
